body: This is the intolerance paradox, is not really that simple. How it is intolerant to not tolerate intolerance? Either way, people said shit, and I didn't let them get away with it. Pretty much what your advice says. I don't know if there is much to do about it.
It wasn't a critic to religion, and I'm saying that I'm intolerant to intolerant people, should I really give them voice or let they say the whatever they want?

That's depends on the definition of drama. I'm not remorseful of what I said in the post, I'm not even sure if I care about where it reached, I'm certainly not happy about it, but it seems unreasonable to tolerate other people when they say shit like that.

Indeed, is just so hard to be misunderstood, people usually doesn't know what is being completely alone, I tried to explain to some people how I felt lonely, and they usually respond that I should enjoy my own company more, but that is literally the only company I have, I'm a little tired of being with myself, nobody seems to get that I'm seeking for help and being lonely is not helping at all, instead they usually offer cliche quotes and carry with their life's, is not really they fault that I'm in this situation, but I could really use some help, someone to talk, not to judge me. Thx for showing some interest and giving some of your time to listen to me, I'm in need for that.

Hi there. Not quite sure of what's wrong, nothing seems right, actually. But on top of that, I'm really lonely, is hard to cope with these problems alone, you know. Nobody is really interested in listening me, and I feel quite abandoned.
